_comment: Spec consumed by the bump-manifests skill. For each workspace folder, it Stats each `source` object on the target backend (at <backend-base>/unittests/workspaces/<source>) and emits a `.manifest` file at <backend-base>/unittests/workspaces/<workspace>/.manifest, in the standard manifest JSON format, with one entry per item: { relative_path, resource_info: { resource_identity, size, modified_time } } from the Stat response. `source` paths are relative to unittests/workspaces/. Do not 1:1-map relative_path to source — the mapping is intentional (collisions, manifest-only prefixes).
